FAQs

Nail Care Questions

What nail services does Xing offer in Bangalore?

Xing offers manicures, pedicures, nail extensions, nail art, cutting and filing, and nail polish in Bangalore. These are available at our Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout and Brookfield salons, and our HSR Layout salon has a dedicated Nail Bar and pedicure lounge.

Which is the quickest nail service?

Quick Nail Care is the quickest nail service at Xing: a cut, file and polish for tidy nails. It suits you before a meeting, a dinner or a family event, and you can walk in or message your salon on WhatsApp first.

Do you do nail extensions and nail art?

Yes. Xing offers nail extensions and nail art at our Bangalore salons. Your nail technician talks through the length, shape and design you want before starting, and confirms the price with you at that point, so there are no surprises at the end.

How do I book a nail appointment?

You can book a Xing nail appointment on WhatsApp, by calling your nearest salon, or through the booking form on this site. Walk-ins are welcome at all three salons, though booking ahead is the easiest way to get your preferred time.
